title: check registry v2
description: Per-check registration data. Each QC service registers the checks it can emit; S39 reads this to route repairs. Adding a check is a data change here and needs no S39 release. The schema proves the shape; the qc-sdk validator proves the cross-file family constraint (see x-cross-checks).

registry_version.description: Monotonic. Every add/edit bumps it; S39 records which version it routed with.

check_id.description: <LAYER>.<GROUP>.<NAME>, uppercase. Globally unique; the validator rejects duplicates.

owner_service.description: The QC service that emits this check. S35 / S36 / S37 / S38 today.

defect_type.description: Must be in action-families.v2.json closed_type_set. Selecting the action family is the ONLY thing this field does.

default_action.description: The family chain's starting point for this check. MUST be a member of families[defect_type].chain.

allowed_actions.description: Subset of families[defect_type].chain. Intersected with the family and with policy to get the candidate set. May NOT widen what the family permits.

window_scope.description: How much of the artifact the repair touches, and therefore how much must be re-checked.

window_max_frames.description: When window_scope is frame or window: the largest window this check may report. Gates keyframe_edit, whose precondition is <= 6.

severity_max.description: Ceiling a model-backed detector may raise to. Registration decides severity; the detector may only raise toward this, never lower it.

recheck_scope.description: Which layer(s) re-run after the repair. Determines the re-check cost, so it is data, not code.

never_auto_repair.description: True forbids every automatic route regardless of what the family allows, forcing human_review. Use for defects where any automatic action would change creative intent.

no_auto_reason.description: Required when never_auto_repair is true: why no automatic route exists. Surfaced to the reviewer, so it must be a sentence a human can act on.

notes.description: Free text for the registering team. Not read by S39.

metric.description: What is measured against the threshold, e.g. defect_ratio, consecutive_frames, attempt_count.

escalate_to.description: Where in the family chain to jump when the threshold trips. Must also be in families[defect_type].chain.

x-cross-checks.why: JSON Schema cannot reference another file's data. These rules are enforced by the qc-sdk registry validator AT LOAD TIME. A registry that violates any of them is rejected and the service fails to start; it is not logged and ignored.
rules: Every defect_type is in action-families.v2.json closed_type_set.
owner_service matches the layer: technical→S35, semantic→S36, alignment→S37, subtitle→S38. A layer served by a different service is a registration error, not a new convention.
check_id namespace must match the layer: TECH→technical, VIS→semantic, AUD→alignment, SUB→subtitle.
x-cross-checks.why_load_time: The registry is data owned by four different services and edited under deadline. A prose rule gets broken the first time someone adds a check in a hurry. Load-time rejection is the only version of the constraint that survives.
